verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is fundamentally a code-first engine: its documented JS/TS API (TypeDoc reference, Scene Management, Meshes & Geometry docs, NullEngine for headless/server-side use) already lets any script or agent create scenes, nodes and edit properties programmatically. However, there is no documented 'editor' automation surface (e.g. scripting the Inspector or Playground) and no build/trigger concept analogous to a project build pipeline. Missing for 10: documented API for driving the Inspector/Playground GUI tools, a 'build/export' trigger mechanism, and independent evidence of agent-driven end-to-end scene editing.
